Enhancing Bioprinting Precision through Real-Time Monitoring of Stand-Off Distance: a preliminary study

Alessandro Margarita, Simone Giovanni Gugliandolo, Bianca Maria Colosimo Procedia CIRP 2026-01-01 10.1016/j.procir.2026.01.207
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Via La Masa, 1, 20156, Milano, Italy
通讯: Bianca Maria Colosimo @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Via La Masa, 1, 20156, Milano, Italy
相关性: 该论文涉及生物打印中喷嘴与基板距离的实时监测，但未集成AI算法或机器学习模型，仅作为传感与控制的基础研究。
边界: No AI/ML integration; purely sensor-based monitoring without predictive or autonomous decision-making.
动机· 提高生物打印精度，需要实时监控打印参数。
方法· 使用数字显微镜实时测量喷嘴与基板距离，以优化打印参数。
结果· 成功实现离面距离的实时监测，为闭环控制提供基础。
验证· 利用不同浓度的海藻酸明胶进行实验验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To enhance bioprinting quality, real-time monitoring of printing parameters is essential.
Method· A digital microscope measures the stand-off distance between nozzle and substrate in real-time for parameter optimization.
Result· Real-time distance monitoring was achieved, laying the foundation for closed-loop control.
Validation· Experiments were conducted using gelatine alginate at various concentrations.

Motivation· Chronic diabetic wounds suffer from persistent hypoxia, motivating the development of a regenerative graft that monitors wound microenvironment.
Method· A personalized skin graft was fabricated by 3D bioprinting decellularized porcine skin ECM bioink incorporated with LiNC-BuO oxygen microsensors.
Result· The printed ECM grafts exhibited cytocompatibility, low immunogenicity, and real-time non-invasive oxygen monitoring in vitro and in vivo.
Validation· Validation included DNA quantification, SEM, rheology, in vitro cytocompatibility assays, and in vivo implantation in animals.

相关性: 本研究开发了一种骨科植入物抗菌涂层，但未涉及LPBF制造、多孔结构、疲劳测试或应力屏蔽等核心方向。

动机· 为解决骨科植入物的感染和无菌松动问题

English summary & terms
Motivation· To address bacterial infection, aseptic loosening, and poor osseointegration of orthopedic implants.
Method· A dual-network polyelectrolyte coating composed of PEI and PAA was prepared via UV-triggered in situ polymerization, with immobilized antimicrobial peptide ε-poly-L-lysine.
Result· The coating showed excellent antibacterial activity against Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria and enhanced osteoblast adhesion, proliferation, and differentiation in vitro, and resisted infection in vivo.
Validation· In vitro cell and bacterial assays and in vivo animal infection model.

AL Galinovsky, Y.A. Nosov, M.I. Abashin, V.S. Boldyrev, D.A. Bunakov et al. Electrical Metallurgy 2026-01-01 10.31044/1684-5781-2026-0-3-18-31

相关性: 该论文专注于SLM过程的缺陷检测，未涉及生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合问题。
边界: No stress shielding analysis, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no biomedical implant context, no osseointegration or surface roughness evaluation.
动机· 解决SLM过程中缺陷检测问题，提高打印质量。
方法· 通过分析每层光学图像并辅以CT验证，使用人工缺陷样本校准特征。
结果· 光学与CT结合能可靠识别球形和裂纹缺陷，提出适合过程诊断的检测方法。
验证· 使用人工缺陷（不同功率）和自然缺陷的SLM样本进行光学与CT对比验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To address defect detection in selective laser melting by combining optical layer images with CT verification.
Method· A sample with artificial defects (pores and cracks) was fabricated using varied laser power, and optical images were fused with CT data for defect localization.
Result· The proposed method reliably detects spherical and crack-like defects, enabling in-process diagnostics and printing parameter tuning.
Validation· Validation used artificially seeded defects (0% and 50% laser power) and natural defects, confirmed by CT scanning.

Validation· Experimental tensile testing comparing two specimen geometries.

Multi-physical prediction and regime identification of lack-of-fusion porosity in selective laser melting

Ce Liu, Shangpeng Li, Huangwei Zhang Physics of Fluids 2026-01-01 10.1063/5.0296598
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, National University of Singapore 1 , 9 Engineering Drive 1, 117576
通讯: Ce Liu @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, National University of Singapore 1 , 9 Engineering Drive 1, 117576
相关性: 该论文采用CFD模拟研究选区激光熔化中的孔隙缺陷，与您的FEA代理建模方向在方法上差异较大。
边界: This paper does not use FEA or surrogate modeling; it employs direct CFD simulation for SLM porosity, not transferable to implant/biomechanics design.
动机· 预测SLM中未融合孔隙缺陷，提升打印件机械完整性
方法· 基于OpenFOAM的三维CFD模型，引入修正线能量密度和热扩散系数
结果· 熔池穿透深度是关键指标，发现M形和波浪形非线性边界
验证· 基于文献校准、不确定性量化、交叉验证和独立实验验证
English summary & terms
Motivation· To predict lack-of-fusion porosity in selective laser melting for improving mechanical integrity of additively manufactured parts.
Method· A three-dimensional CFD model in OpenFOAM incorporating surface tension, Marangoni flow, recoil pressure, and laser reflection, with proposed revised linear energy density and heat diffusivity parameters.
Result· Melt pool penetration depth is identified as a critical indicator, revealing nonlinear M-shaped and wave-like boundaries between laser and thermal indexes.
Validation· Simulation results are validated through literature calibration, uncertainty quantification, cross-validated classification, and independent experimental data.
selective laser melting · 选区激光熔化lack-of-fusion porosity · 未融合孔隙computational fluid dynamics · 计算流体动力学OpenFOAM · OpenFOAMMarangoni flow · 马兰戈尼流recoil pressure · 反冲压力linear energy density · 线能量密度regime map · 状态图uncertainty quantification · 不确定性量化

Revision rates of porous-coated versus grit-blasted femoral stems in cementless total hip arthroplasty: A systematic review.

Sashrik Sribhashyam, Robert S Chin, Aadi Sharma, Brady Ernst, Matthew S Smith et al. Journal of orthopaedics 2026-01-01 10.1016/j.jor.2025.08.023
单位: Virginia Commonwealth University School of Medicine, Richmond, VA, USA.
通讯: Jibanananda Satpathy @ Virginia Commonwealth University Health System, Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Richmond, VA, USA. [推断]
相关性: 该论文是一篇临床系统综述，比较不同表面涂层的股骨柄翻修率，未涉及应力分析或有限元建模，仅提供背景信息。
边界: This is a clinical systematic review that does not include any finite element analysis, stress/strain quantification, micromotion modeling, or comparison of intact vs implanted femur mechanics.
动机· 比较多孔涂层与喷砂股骨柄的翻修率差异。
方法· 系统综述PRISMA方法检索12项研究共1987髋。
结果· 多孔涂层柄翻修率1.5%，喷砂柄9.2%。
验证· 无，仅为临床文献汇总。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To compare revision rates and functional outcomes between porous-coated and grit-blasted femoral stems in cementless primary THA.
Method· A systematic review following PRISMA guidelines was conducted across PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane databases up to October 2024, including 12 studies with 1987 hips.
Result· Porous-coated stems showed a lower aggregated revision rate of 1.5% versus 9.2% for grit-blasted stems, with improved Harris Hip Scores.
Validation· No experimental or numerical validation; the study aggregates clinical revision data from published literature.

Validation· No validation; this is a review paper, not a biomechanical modeling study.

动机· 金属植入物与骨骼弹性模量不匹配导致应力遮挡和离子释放问题。

English summary & terms
Motivation· This review addresses the mismatch in Young's modulus between metal implants and bone, which causes stress shielding and ion release.
Method· It summarizes surface coating and post-processing techniques such as ion implantation, anodization, and laser shock peening.

边界: This paper reports clinical outcomes of hip resurfacing in amputees, with no quantification of femoral stress/strain, micromotion, or any biomechanical modeling of the implant-bone interface.
动机· 评估髋关节表面置换术在下肢截肢患者中的效果
方法· 回顾性观察39名截肢患者的45例髋关节表面置换术
结果· 平均随访13年，假体存活率高，患者满意度好

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate whether hip resurfacing arthroplasty is a successful alternative to total hip arthroplasty for lower extremity amputees with altered gait mechanics.
Method· An observational study reviewed the records of 39 amputee patients (45 hips) who underwent hip resurfacing with a polyethylene acetabular component.
Result· At a mean follow-up of 13 years, implant survivorship and patient-reported outcomes were favorable, with 92% achieving minimal clinically important difference and 85% reaching patient acceptable symptomatic state.
Validation· Validation was based on clinical follow-up including patient-reported outcome scores, radiographic evaluation, and complication tracking.

边界: This paper focuses on fracture fixation plates, not hip implants or femoral stems; it does not quantify stress shielding in Gruen zones or proximal femur micromotion from implant-bone contact.
动机· 评估镁合金降解固定板在骨折愈合中的生物力学可靠性。
方法· 使用CT建立股骨模型，通过Abaqus模拟变形和应力，并进行力学测试。
结果· MVFP在刚度上略低于锁定板，但改善了骨折间隙微动并减少应力遮挡。
验证· 有限元分析和体外力学测试验证了生物力学性能。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the biomechanical reliability of magnesium degradation-induced variable fixation plates for fracture healing.
Method· CT-based femur models were built and simulated in Abaqus, and in vitro mechanical tests including vertical loading, bending, torsion, and fatigue were conducted.
Result· The MVFP showed slightly lower stiffness than locking plates but improved interfragmentary micromotion and reduced stress shielding with adequate fatigue resistance.
Validation· The study performed in vitro mechanical testing (vertical, bending, torsion, fatigue) and finite element analysis to validate the biomechanical performance.

Mahmood R Al Mallah, Sarmad S Salih Al Qassar, Ibrahim B Badran Journal of orthodontic science 2026-01-01 10.4103/jos.jos_166_25

相关性: 该论文研究正畸微种植体，与髋关节植入物和股骨柄完全无关。
边界: This paper does not address hip implants, femoral stems, stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical analysis of the proximal femur.
动机· 评估微种植体形状和直径对初期稳定性的影响。
方法· 在羊胫骨中植入不同形状和直径的钛微种植体，测量不同时间点的峰值拔出扭矩。
结果· 大直径和圆柱形微种植体在后期表现出更高的拔出扭矩。
验证· 通过动物实验和统计检验验证几何参数对稳定性的影响。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the effect of mini-screw implant shape and diameter on primary stability in orthodontic anchorage.
Method· 160 titanium mini-screws of varying shape (cylindrical vs. tapered) and diameter (1.2 vs. 1.4 mm) were inserted into sheep tibiae, and peak removal torque was measured at immediate, 2, 4, and 6 weeks.
Result· Larger diameter and cylindrical implants showed significantly higher removal torque at later time points.
Validation· Animal experiment with three-way ANOVA on peak removal torque data.

通讯: Ping Li @ School and Hospital of Stomatology, Guangdong Engineering Research Center of Oral Restoration and Reconstruction & Guang [推断]
相关性: 该论文聚焦于生物材料表面的免疫微环境，而非髋关节植入物的力学性能评估。
边界: The paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain/micromotion, does not involve finite element modeling, and lacks any mechanical or structural analysis relevant to hip implant stress shielding.
动机· 探究氧化锆种植体骨结合低于钛的免疫机制。
方法· 利用单细胞RNA测序比较钛和氧化锆种植体周围免疫-基质细胞图谱。
结果· 钛促再生微环境，氧化锆诱导促炎纤维化微环境。
验证· 体内bulk RNA测序验证材料特异性免疫调节模式。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To elucidate the osteoimmune mechanisms underlying the inferior osseointegration of zirconia implants compared to titanium.
Method· Single-cell RNA sequencing was employed to profile immune-stromal cell dynamics at the bone-implant interface for both materials.
Result· Titanium promoted regenerative extracellular matrix remodeling and an early osteogenic microenvironment, whereas zirconia triggered lymphoid-dominated pro-inflammatory responses.
Validation· Bulk RNA sequencing of in vivo samples confirmed the material-specific immunomodulatory programs observed at single-cell resolution.
